premise: Physics depth is demonstrated by correct technical representations and reasoning, not prose volume.

hard_bucket_contract.inferential_jump_rule: Each fragile or major inferential jump must be closed by at least one technically adequate representation; prose alone is insufficient when a diagram, graph, vector construction, table or equation is materially necessary.
hard_bucket_contract.diagram_count_rule: No quota. A diagram is required by conceptual need, not decoration.
hard_bucket_contract.technical_density_rule: A Hard learner product must visibly contain the equations, vectors/components, diagrams/graphs and worked manipulations needed to reconstruct the Physics. Long prose explanations do not substitute for technical working.

core1b.hard_bucket_representation_requirement: Each fragile checkpoint that depends on a technical representation must expose an incomplete, fillable, comparable or reconstructable version of that representation to the learner.
examples: label a free-body or frame diagram
derive or rearrange a symbolic relation
core1b.prohibited_failure_mode: A Hard Core1B consisting mainly of prose prompts and blank answer lines without technical diagrams/equations/representations is noncompliant.

core2a.solution_level_rule: Worked problem learning must show expert representation and intermediate technical working, not only narrative explanation and final answer.

core2b.attempt_level_rule: Transfer tasks must require the learner to select or construct the technical representation/model before solution reveal when that representation is part of the capability.
